dēlēnĭfĭcus (delin- ), a, um, adj. delenio-facio,
I.soothing, caressing, captivating, flattering, enchanting (ante- and postclass.): verba, Lucil. ap. Fulg. 567, 24: “facta,” Plaut. Mil. 2, 2, 39 : ingenium mulierum, Turp. ap. Non. 278, 2: Fronto Ep. ad Ver. 1 al.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
